verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirms a live llms.txt at docs.extend.ai/llms.txt (HTTP 200). Extend also serves Markdown versions of its doc pages (.md URLs) and has a dedicated Agent Quickstart covering agents that use MCP, run the CLI, or write SDK code. Together these give an agent clear, agent-oriented docs to point at. Missing for 10: no independent or community report of agents actually using llms.txt or the agent docs in practice, and no evidence of an llms-full.txt or equivalent full-content dump.
